name: Powder Mountain

links_notes.Lightning Ridge (top): James Peak adventure terrain (gate hours 9:00-2:15 on the 2026 trail map): along the ridge from Cobabe Peak (the top of Lightning Ridge) and up the uptrack drawn to James Peak; the James Peak runs (James Face, Carpe Diem, Shug'r Bowl, Y Chute, K2) start there
links_notes.Village Quad (base): Lefty's Canyon is marked 'No lift access, hiking out required' on the 2026 trail map (Village is a member lift): the uptrack 'Uptrack Exiting Lefty's Canyon' climbs from the canyon floor at the bottom of Village up beside Ojeebus to the Skylodge and Hidden Lake Lodge, where Lodge Trail starts
links_notes.trail:Spring Creek (bottom): the lower uptrack on the 2026 trail map ('Uptrack Exiting Lefty's Canyon', dash-dot with arrows) climbs from the canyon floor where Spring Creek and Colt 45 end up to the gate at the bottom of Village (walked)
links_notes.trail:Colt 45 (bottom): the lower uptrack on the 2026 trail map ('Uptrack Exiting Lefty's Canyon', dash-dot with arrows) climbs from the canyon floor where Spring Creek and Colt 45 end up to the gate at the bottom of Village (walked)

split_ways_note: Wonderland (way 1132346824) runs from the top of Mary's along the ridge, past the tops of Yin, Yang and Bluebell, then down Mary's Bowl. The ridge part is the top of Lay of the Land on the 2026 trail map (public); the Mary's Bowl part is member terrain and hidden (official json 'hide').
